task: Strict binary-to-text codecs: Base64/Base32 (RFC 4648), Base58/Base58Check, Bech32/Bech32m and Segwit addresses
reasoning_summary: A shared BaseN bit-group core serves strict RFC 4648 Base64/Base32 with per-remainder length validity; Base58 uses schoolbook radix conversion checked against a BigInteger oracle; Bech32/Bech32m share one polymod with a variant constant, and Segwit layers version/variant/length rules. Tests combine published vectors, JDK differential checks, exhaustive character-substitution checks and a 13-mutant pass.
